2.

This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant seeking direction to the Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C. IInd, Firozabad to decide the Case No.8350 of 2020 (State vs. Saurabh Bhadauria) under Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Mahila Thana,
